text:
Ava Morgan: Morning — quick kickoff for the Rainfield customer launch story. Need to lock interview window, capture quote, and confirm legal clearance. Who can help with scheduling + share release form?
Marco Diaz: I can handle scheduling. Customer prefers mornings PT. Free windows: Mon 10:30–11, Tue 9–9:30, Wed 11–11:45. Which works?
Helen Park: Need to know recording format and assets (headshots, logo, short bio). Is b-roll allowed?
Jon Liu: Draft interview questions below — keep it to 6 Qs + 1 closing quote ask.
Jon Liu: ```
1) How are you using Redwood Inference today?
2) What metrics moved after adoption (latency/cost/throughput)?
3) Any unexpected wins or gotchas?
4) Who on your team owns inference ops?
5) How does Redwood change your rollout confidence?
6) One-sentence advice for teams evaluating inference platforms?
Closing: Can you share a short quote we can edit and approve?
```
Priya Sinha: Quick legal note — we'll need a signed release. Use the new short-form release (no lawyer review). Also confirm whether the customer wants their logo and company name public. If they do, we need a signed permission for logo usage.
Ava Morgan: @Marco please propose 2 slots to the customer and cc marketing@redwood.com. We'll default to 30 mins. Add a 10-min buffer for technical checks.
Marco Diaz: Sending now. I'll ping when they confirm.
LaunchBot: Reminder: attach release form from https://redwood.app/legal/releases/short-form before interview.
Helen Park: For assets — can you ask them to send HQ headshot (vertical and square), logo SVG, and 2-3 screenshots of the product in-app?
Marco Diaz: Got it. Also asked for 1–2 bullets on tangible impact (numbers or %).
Jon Liu: For the quote approval process — timeline idea: customer returns quote within 48hrs, marketing edits and sends back, customer signs off within 3 business days. Sound ok?
Priya Sinha: That timeline is fine. We should explicitly state quotes will be editable and require final sign-off. I'll draft a one-paragraph consent blurb they can initial.
Ava Morgan: Nice. Once slot is confirmed I'll create the run-of-show and share recording link. Template: /templates/case_study/run_of_show.md — will paste core items below.
Ava Morgan: ```
- 00:00 - intro, purpose (Ava)
- 02:00 - customer intro + context (Marco)
- 05:00 - Q&A (Jon)
- 25:00 - closing + quote ask (Jon)
- 30:00 - end, next steps for approvals (Ava)
```
Marco Diaz: Customer picked Tue 9–9:30 PT. I'll send calendar invite for 9–9:40 (10-min buffer). Inviteing: Marco, Ava, Jon, and customer contacts.
Helen Park: I'll prepare a quick one-slide visual (impact snapshot) — need numbers from Marco as soon as he has them.
Priya Sinha: Upload signed release to the case folder and cc legal@redwood. We'll mark 'logo ok' or 'logo withheld' there.
Ava Morgan: Great — next steps: Marco to send invite + release link; customer to provide assets and impact bullets; Jon will prep final Qs; Priya to supply consent blurb. I'll post the run-of-show once invite lands. :thumbsup:
Marco Diaz: On it, will update thread when customer accepts.
LaunchBot: Note: add tag #customer-story to the calendar event for internal tracking.
Marco Diaz: Accepted by customer. They approved public name and logo, and will send assets by EOD Friday.
Ava Morgan: Perfect — closing this planning thread. Moving assets/approvals to the doc and channel #marketing-assets for final handoff.
